data.title: Smart Shopper: Comparing Discounts and Final Prices
data.description: Analyze multi-step shopping scenarios by calculating sale prices on percent bars to determine which deal is truly the best bargain.

challenges.scenario: Outfitters sells a jacket for $30 at 10% off. StyleCo sells the same a jacket for $50 at 50% off.
challenges.question: Step 1 — Outfitters: place the sale price as a percent of its original ($30).

steps.prompt: Step 1 — Outfitters: place the sale price as a percent of its original ($30).
steps.hint: 10% off means you pay 100% − 10% = 90%. The value shows the sale price.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — StyleCo: place the sale price as a percent of its original ($50).
steps.hint: 50% off means you pay 100% − 50% = 50%. The value shows the sale price.
Compare the two sale prices you found. The larger price costs more — a bigger % off is not always the better deal.
